ruleset.name: Kiln tests
ruleset.description: Rules for test code (BUILD-11): no fully qualified names an import would replace, no unnecessary imports, nothing unused, no sleeping and no network. Tests aren't held to the production smell rules.

rule.name: KilnNoSleepInTests
rule.message: Don't sleep in tests: wait on a latch, a future or a condition instead
rule.description: Sleeping makes tests slow and flaky.

rule.name: KilnNoNetworkInTests
rule.message: Unit tests don't use the network; use recorded responses
rule.description: Tests must pass offline and without external services.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassType[pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.Socket') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.ServerSocket') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.URLConnection') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.net.http.HttpClient') or pmd-java:typeIs('java.nio.channels.SocketChannel')] | //MethodCall[pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.URL#openConnection(_*)') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.net.URL#openStream()')]
